title: Tight Lower Bounds for State Tomography with Limited Entanglement
abstract: arXiv:2609.05718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study state tomography when each measurement acts on at most $k$ fresh copies and no quantum memory is retained between blocks. We prove a lower bound matching the upper bound in [arXiv:2510.07788]. Thus the copy complexity of estimating an arbitrary $d$-dimensional state to trace distance $\epsilon$ is, up to absolute constant factors, $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2),d^2/\epsilon^2\}$ for every $k$ and all sufficiently small $\epsilon$. This removes the earlier restriction that $k$ be small as a function of the accuracy. The lower bound applies to arbitrary measurements within each block and adaptive choices between blocks. The lower bound already applies in a small neighborhood of any state whose smallest eigenvalue is of order $1/d$, even when the center is known. translated_title: 有限纠缠条件下量子态层析的紧致下界
translated_abstract: 我们研究量子态层析问题，其中每次测量最多作用于 $k$ 个新鲜副本，且各测量块之间不保留量子存储器。我们证明了一个与 [arXiv:2510.07788] 中上界相匹配的下界。因此，对于每个 $k$ 以及所有足够小的 $\epsilon$，在迹距离 $\epsilon$ 下估计任意 $d$ 维量子态的副本复杂度（在绝对常数因子范围内）为 $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2), d^2/\epsilon^2\}$。这消除了早期要求 $k$ 必须随精度参数保持较小的限制。该下界适用于每个块内的任意测量以及块之间的自适应选择。该下界在最小本征值数量级为 $1/d$ 的任意量子态的小邻域内即已成立，即使该中心态是已知的。证明的核心是一个仅依赖于量子态最小本征值的单个测量块的一致费希尔信息界。该证明避免了之前的...
tldr: 本文证明了在每次测量最多使用 $k$ 个新鲜副本且无量子存储的受限纠缠设定下，$d$ 维量子态层析的副本复杂度下界为 $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2), d^2/\epsilon^2\}$，与已知上界紧致匹配，并适用于任意块内测量和块间自适应策略。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a tight copy-complexity lower bound $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2), d^2/\epsilon^2\}$ for state tomography under limited entanglement (at most $k$ fresh copies per measurement block, no quantum memory between blocks), matching the known upper bound and holding for arbitrary block measurements and adaptive strategies between blocks.
